author: kubilaya
quote: A massive disappointment. First, ignoring the PC community at launch is unacceptable—forcing fans to buy a console after years of waiting is a huge letdown. On top of that, being locked at 30 FPS on modern hardware completely ruins the experience, making driving and combat feel **** make matters worse, the story is pure trash. It completely lacks the depth, memorable characters, and engaging pacing of previous games. Pretty graphics can't save a shallow script and terrible performance. Skip it until the PC version finally drops.
